title: One Whole, Many Parts
subtitle: The Moon Lantern Workshop
author: Maria Smith
medium_contract: Connected picture book that works without the companion game

pages.text: One Whole, Many Parts
pages.alt: Mia, Sol, Tavi and Pax stand together in a moonlit workshop around an empty round worktable, ready for the Moon Lantern adventure.

pages.text: One Whole, Many Parts
pages.subtext:
Written by Maria Smith

Book 2 of 4 · Review edition 2.0.0
Ages 3–5 · Read, point, trace, count and play
pages.alt: A clean title page shows the stable Moon Lantern, moon and door emoji above the edition information.

pages.text:
Mia, Sol and Tavi had solved their first mystery.

Now the parcel from the tower slide waited on the rug.
pages.alt: Mia, Sol and Tavi kneel on the library rug beside the same parcel that came down the tall wooden tower slide after Book One.

pages.text:
Mia opened the parcel.

Inside was one red Moon Lantern. It was ready for a journey.
pages.alt: The three friends look closely at one complete red Moon Lantern on the library rug.

pages.text:
A picture card showed the balcony at night.

PLEASE BRING THE LANTERN UP BEFORE THE MOON RISES.
pages.alt: The Moon Lantern and a moon picture make the request clear: the lantern belongs on the balcony at night.

pages.text:
The way to the balcony went through a small door.

Sol tried to push the lantern through. Bump! It was too wide to fit.
pages.alt: Mia, Sol and Tavi face one clearly small door. The complete Moon Lantern is wider than the doorway and cannot pass through as a whole.

pages.text:
A purple helper hurried over.

“I’m Pax. I keep every piece safe. Let’s find a way through together.”
pages.alt: Pax, the purple helper in a teal pocket apron, joins Mia, Sol and Tavi around the complete lantern. Pax is the only new friend in this book.

pages.heading: Lantern Detective
pages.text: Which picture is the same lantern Mia took from the parcel? Point before you turn the page.
pages.alt: Three lantern pictures appear: one is missing a quarter, one is complete, and one has an extra star attached.

pages.heading: This one matches
pages.text:
Every lantern part is here. No lantern part is missing. No extra piece was added.

This is one whole lantern.
pages.alt: The complete Moon Lantern stands alone on the round worktable. All of it is present, with no missing place and no extra piece.

pages.text:
Pax showed two lines where the lantern could open.

“These are seams. One goes down. One goes across. What do you think will open?”
pages.alt: The complete Moon Lantern sits on the table with one vertical and one horizontal seam crossing at its middle.

pages.heading: Seam Hunt
pages.text: Trace down the lantern. Then trace across it. How many parts might open?
pages.alt: A large Moon Lantern is divided by one vertical and one horizontal gold tracing line.

pages.heading: Four parts opened
pages.text:
One, two, three, four!

The same whole lantern had opened into four parts.
pages.alt: Four separate pieces of the same Moon Lantern rest on the worktable, labelled one to four above.

pages.text:
“Each piece is one part,” said Mia.

“All four parts belong to the same whole lantern.”
pages.alt: The four separate Moon Lantern pieces remain together on the worktable while Mia names each one as a part.

pages.heading: Count Keeper
pages.text: Follow the gold trail. Touch each lantern part once. Say one, two, three, four.
pages.alt: Four separate lantern parts sit on one looping gold trail that visits every part once.

pages.heading: Every part once
pages.text:
You counted four parts. You did not skip one. You did not count one twice.

That is a clear count.
pages.alt: The four Moon Lantern parts are each labelled with one different count number from one to four.

pages.text:
Pax opened the little door.

“The whole lantern was too wide, but each part is small enough. We can carry them one at a time.”
pages.alt: The four lantern parts wait with Mia, Sol and Tavi on one side of the open small door. Pax waits on the other side with an empty tray.

pages.heading: Doorway Parade
pages.text: Trace one path for each part. Make sure all four paths go through the open door.
pages.alt: Four lantern parts begin on the left. Four coloured paths pass through the small open door to Pax's tray.

pages.heading: All four arrived
pages.text:
Every part came through the door. No part stayed behind.

Pax kept all four together on the tray.
pages.alt: All four lantern parts are together on Pax's tray on the far side of the small door.

pages.text:
Before rebuilding, Pax checked the parts.

“Each one must fit one same-size place in the lantern frame.”
pages.alt: Four lantern pieces are lined up on the empty worktable while Pax asks the team to compare their places.

pages.heading: Same-Size Pairs
pages.text: Which pair has two pieces the same size? Point to Pair A or Pair B.
pages.alt: Pair A shows two matching-size lantern-part cards. Pair B shows one large and one small lantern-part card.

pages.heading: Pair A is the same size
pages.text:
Both pieces in Pair A are the same size.

Same-size parts can return to same-size places.
pages.alt: Pair A is outlined in gold. Its two lantern-part cards have matching outer sizes.

pages.heading: The Missing Place
pages.text: Three lantern parts are in the frame. Which part fits the empty place?
pages.alt: A two-by-two lantern frame contains three correct quarters and one empty bottom-right place, with three answer pieces beside it.

pages.heading: The last part fits
pages.text:
The bottom-right part fills the place.

All four places are full. There is no gap. No part covers another.
pages.alt: All four quarters fill the two-by-two lantern frame without a gap or overlap.

pages.text:
On the balcony, Mia carried two parts. Pax carried two parts.

“How many parts are here together?” asked Tavi.
pages.alt: Two lantern parts rest on Mia's gold tray and two rest on Pax's teal tray while Sol and Tavi look between the groups.

pages.heading: Add Together
pages.text: Count Mia’s two parts. Count Pax’s two parts. Which total is right: 3, 4 or 5?
pages.alt: Two parts sit on Mia's tray and two on Pax's tray. The child chooses whether the groups together contain three, four or five parts.

pages.heading: Two plus two equals four
pages.text:
2 parts + 2 parts = 4 parts.

Plus joins the groups. Equals says both sides count the same four parts.
pages.alt: The same two-and-two groups remain visible while the exact equation two parts plus two parts equals four parts is explained.

pages.text:
Four counted parts waited around the empty frame.

“Every part has one matching place,” said Pax.
pages.alt: A blank two-by-two lantern frame sits on the worktable with the four matching lantern quarters around it.

pages.heading: Lantern Builder
pages.text: Trace each lantern part to its matching place. Use every part once.
pages.alt: Four lantern quarters sit around an empty two-by-two frame, each joined to its matching place by a gold trace line.

pages.heading: The whole is back
pages.text:
Every part is in its place. The same whole lantern is ready again.

1 part + 1 part + 1 part + 1 part = 4 parts.
Four parts make 1 whole lantern.
pages.alt: The complete Moon Lantern stands rebuilt on the worktable, with every one of its four parts back in place.

pages.heading: You solved it
pages.text:
You began with one whole lantern. You found four parts, counted each once, carried all four and fitted them back.

Plus joined the groups. The equals sign showed that both sides counted the same four parts. This helps us keep every piece and rebuild things correctly.
pages.alt: The rebuilt Moon Lantern stands on the balcony pedestal while Mia, Sol, Tavi and Pax celebrate the completed journey.

pages.text:
The Moon Lantern shone on the balcony.

Pax waved goodbye. Mia, Sol and Tavi had kept every part and rebuilt the same whole.
pages.alt: The complete lantern glows on its balcony pedestal. The permanent trio stand together while Pax waves goodbye by the workshop door.

pages.text:
Then three pictures glowed on the lantern: moon, sun, moon. A fourth space stayed blank.

“What might come next?” asked Tavi.
pages.subtext: The next Star Rooms adventure begins with a pattern.
pages.alt: Above the complete lantern, the stable emoji pictures moon, sun and moon appear in order, followed by one blank place asking what comes next.
